title: 118-126 char natural title containing the exact model; no banned words; substantive wording, no filler padding
title_sha256: sha256 of the exact title text
sales_unit_note: Must match the copy source. The executor does not write this field; a family whose unit differs from the copy source is an unresolved limit.
weight_rule: tiered: moq_total < 3 kg -> +1.5 kg; >= 3 kg -> +2.0 kg; exactly 3 kg belongs to the >= tier
lead_quantity_rule: derived from MOQ by the executor adapter; never left as a literal string
lead_days_note: uniform fixed value from the rules file, not the template's inherited value
store_group_note: The store exposes a fixed tree of existing groups. No free-text input and no create entry. Map explicitly; never inherit the default.
category_note: If true, the executor switches category before any field write and verifies it on the saved server page.
detail_image_note: First detail image is a real gloved-hand model shot for this family; a legible engraving is not required because a human reviews it. Fall back to the model-note image with needs_review=true only when no glove photo exists.

video_bank.note: Name/VID/non-FST registered from one row; executor does not replay video

image_bank.note: Prepared registration when available; selected local files are a valid fallback. Cross-group duplicates are allowed; check duplicates within a group only.

platform_dedup_status: CHECKED_BY_PREPARER - evidence in handoff; executor does not re-check
oe_note: platform normalization strips - & / etc; a substring match is not a category check
model_visibility: where the model is legible in the chosen images

title_review.title_sha256: sha256 of the exact title text
title_review.basis: why every category/tech word is supported; no filler phrase used to reach the length floor

condition_source: Explicit approval for this product/batch; a template is not approval

price_tiers.basis: Confirmed batch policy; no discount inherited from another batch. The executor adds the second row explicitly.

executor_contract.validator: generational validator with an explicit version match; CARD_READY required
executor_contract.save: draft only; capture business response and new draft ID
executor_contract.readback: same saved ID re-opened from the server; ordered checks include category, group, MOQ, lead-time quantity/days, gross weight, both price rows, condition, media counts/order and video associations

business_pending.fact: Example only; replace with this batch approval before execution
